title: 第十二章 谁争风吃醋？
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“还有什么事？”姜枝真的不想再和这只杂交品种沟通了，天晓得她再待下去原主的眼泪是不是要把她淹死。

翎夜首领此刻已经恢复成那副冷静自持的样子，仿佛刚才那点失态从未出现过。

“希望你

姜枝皱眉：“谁争风吃醋？”

翎夜没有接她这句，只居高临下地看着她。

“再有下次，我会亲自将你逐出部落。”

逐出就逐出呗。

姜枝心里嘀咕。

说实话，她现在对这个部落也没有多大归属感。

山洞漏风，吃饭靠烤，洗澡靠天，出门连个像样的路都没有。

昨晚要不是她从购物车里掏了点东西出来，她现在还得睡在一堆不知道多久没晒过的兽皮上。

就这生活条件，放现代高低算荒野求生。

真把她赶出去，她找个山清水秀的地方一躺，舒服多了。

当然，前提是外面没有什么吃人的猛兽。

姜枝想到这里，又默默把那点嚣张收回来一半。

毕竟这地方连兽人都能长耳朵长尾巴，外面冒出点奇怪东西也很合理。

所以，她面上没和翎夜硬顶，只敷衍地点了点头。

“行，知道了。”

翎夜看着她这副油盐不进的样子，眉心微不可察地压了压。

姜枝却懒得再跟他掰扯，转身就走。

出了小雌性的山洞，她才长长吐出一口气。

身后那股让人不舒服的压迫感终于淡了些，原主残留的那点乱七八糟情绪也慢慢散开。

姜枝揉了揉脸，决定先熟悉一下环境。

万一哪天真要搬去荒郊野岭养老，也得提前踩点。

姜枝沿着部落绕了一圈，很快发现一个残酷事实。

这里落后是真落后。

她购物车里随便拎一样东西出来，都像科技扶贫。

系统幽幽提醒：

【→_→宿主不要小看原始文明喵。】

【虽然生活方式落后，但兽人的战斗力很强喵。】

系统还没解释完，姜枝耳边忽然“铛”的一声巨响。

姜枝吓得一抖。

那声音接连不断，尖锐又急促，像有人拿着石锤在疯狂敲击巨大的空心石壁。

铛！铛！铛！

原本慢悠悠走动的兽人像炸开一样乱了起来。

“龙来了！”

“东边！东边天上——”

Page (1/3)

"What else is there?" Jiang Zhi really didn't want to communicate with this hybrid anymore. God knows if the original owner's tears would drown her if she stayed any longer.

Leader Ling Ye had now returned to his calm and self-possessed appearance, as if the gaffe just now had never occurred.

"I hope you

Jiang Zhi frowned: "Who is jealous?"

Lingye didn't answer her words and just looked at her condescendingly.

“Next time, I will personally expel you from the tribe."

Just evict.

Jiang Zhi muttered in his heart.

To be honest, she doesn't have much sense of belonging to this tribe now.

The cave is leaky, so you rely on the grill to eat, the sky to bathe, and there is no decent way out.

If she hadn't taken something out of the shopping cart last night, she would still be sleeping on a pile of animal skins that hadn't been exposed to the sun for who knows how long.

Given these living conditions, survival in the wilderness is a matter of modern times.

If he really kicked her out, she would find a place with beautiful scenery to lie down, and she would feel much more comfortable.

Of course, the premise is that there are no man-eating beasts outside.

Jiang Zhi thought of this and silently took back half of his arrogance.

After all, even orcs can grow ears and tails in this place, so it makes sense that something strange would pop up outside.

Therefore, she did not confront Ling Ye, but nodded perfunctorily.

"Okay, got it."

Ling Ye looked at her indifferent expression and frowned imperceptibly.

Jiang Zhi was too lazy to talk to him any more, so he turned around and left.

After exiting the little female's cave, she let out a long breath.

The uncomfortable pressure behind him finally faded away, and the remaining messy emotions of the original owner slowly dissipated.

Jiang Zhi rubbed his face and decided to familiarize himself with the environment first.

If you really want to move to the wilderness one day to retire, you have to check out the location in advance.

Jiang Zhi walked around the tribe and soon discovered a cruel fact.

The backwardness here is really backward.

When she takes out any item in her shopping cart, it looks like technology is helping the poor.

System faint reminder:

【→_→Host, don’t underestimate primitive civilization, meow.】

[Although their lifestyle is backward, the orcs are very powerful in combat.】

Before the system finished explaining, there was a loud "ding" in Jiang Zhi's ear.

Jiang Zhi trembled in fright.

The sound was continuous, sharp and urgent, like someone using a stone hammer to knock crazily on a huge hollow stone wall.

Bang!Bang!Bang!

The orcs who were walking slowly became chaotic as if they exploded.

"The dragon is coming!"

“East!In the sky to the east——"
